-----------------------------
--DimCustomer
------------------------

IF NOT EXISTS
(
    SELECT *
    FROM sys.tables t
    JOIN sys.schemas s
        ON t.schema_id = s.schema_id
    WHERE t.name = 'dimcustomer'
      AND s.name = 'gold'
)
BEGIN
    CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE gold.dimcustomer
    WITH
    (
        LOCATION = 'dimcustomer/',
        DATA_SOURCE = gold,
        FILE_FORMAT = parquet_format
    )
    AS
   SELECT *,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY T.CustomerID) AS DimCustomerKey
     FROM
     (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        CustomerID,
        CustomerName,
        CustomerEmail,
        Domain
    FROM silver.SilverTable
     ) AS T;
END;

-----------------------------
--DimProduct
-----------------------------
IF NOT EXISTS
(
    SELECT *
    FROM sys.tables t
    JOIN sys.schemas s
        ON t.schema_id = s.schema_id
    WHERE t.name = 'dimproduct'
      AND s.name = 'gold'
)
BEGIN
    CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE gold.dimproduct
    WITH
    (
        LOCATION = 'dimproduct',
        DATA_SOURCE = gold,
        FILE_FORMAT = parquet_format
    )
    AS
   SELECT *,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY T.ProductID) AS DimProductKey
   FROM
    (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        ProductID,
        ProductName,
        ProductCategory
    FROM silver.SilverTable
    ) AS T;
END;

-----------------------------
--DimGeography
-----------------------------
IF NOT EXISTS
(
    SELECT *
    FROM sys.tables t
    JOIN sys.schemas s
        ON t.schema_id = s.schema_id
    WHERE t.name = 'dimgeo'
      AND s.name = 'gold'
)
BEGIN
    CREATE  EXTERNAL TABLE gold.dimgeo
    WITH
    (
        LOCATION = 'dimgeo/',
        DATA_SOURCE = gold,
        FILE_FORMAT = parquet_format
    )
    AS
   SELECT *,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY T.RegionID) AS DimGeoKey
    FROM
    (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        RegionID,
        Country
    FROM silver.SilverTable
     ) AS T;
END;
-----------------------------
--DimOrders
-----------------------------
IF NOT EXISTS
(
    SELECT *
    FROM sys.tables t
    JOIN sys.schemas s
        ON t.schema_id = s.schema_id
    WHERE t.name = 'dimorders'
      AND s.name = 'gold'
)
BEGIN
    CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE gold.dimorders
    WITH
    (
        LOCATION = 'dimorders',
        DATA_SOURCE = gold,
        FILE_FORMAT = parquet_format
    )
    AS
    SELECT 
        OrderID,
        CustomerID,
        CustomerName,
        CustomerEmail,
        ProductID,
        ProductName,
        ProductCategory,
        Domain,
        RegionID,
        Country,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CustomerID) AS DimordersKey
    FROM silver.SilverTable;
END;
